subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should this protected, stale macOS onboarding PR be closed as superseded by current main, or revived as a narrow rebase with the remaining unique pieces?
rationale: The PR has a protected maintainer label and later merged onboarding PRs cover much of the central behavior, so automation should not choose the product disposition on its own.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this branch in favor of the merged local Gateway and Crestodian onboarding work, inviting a fresh narrow PR for any unique remaining UX polish.

options.title: Request a narrow rebase
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase onto current main and keep only unique, still-needed onboarding changes with live macOS proof.

options.title: Sponsor a maintainer rewrite
options.body: A maintainer can extract the useful ideas into a new branch and own the security and compatibility proof.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Close this branch in favor of the merged local Gateway and Crestodian onboarding work, inviting a fresh narrow PR for any unique remaining UX polish.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged overlapping macOS onboarding PRs were authored by this owner, making them the best available routing candidate for the disposition choice.
